message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the facts: The prosecutor charges that on 2015-10-23, defendant Chen, after drinking, drove a car, was stopped, blood test shows BAC 134.77 mg/100ml. The prosecution says his behavior of drunk driving should be prosecuted. Also says he was in a probation period (考验期) and committed a new crime, so previous penalty should be revoked, multiple crimes, etc. He confessed, can get leniency.

We need to list the crimes that this part of facts directly supports. The fact is drunk driving (driving under influence). Under Chinese criminal law, the crime is "危险驾驶罪" (dangerous driving) or "酒后驾驶罪"? Actually the criminal offense is "危险驾驶罪" (dangerous driving) under Article 133 of Criminal Law, which includes drunk driving causing dangerous circumstances. Also there is "交通肇事罪" if causing accident, but not here. So the appropriate crime is "危险驾驶罪". Also possibly "违反道路交通安全法的行为" is administrative, not criminal. The fact mentions he was in probation period and committed a new crime, which could lead to "撤销缓刑" but that's not a separate crime. So only one crime: "危险驾驶罪". In Chinese law, the term is "危险驾驶罪" (dangerous driving). Some may phrase as "酒后驾驶罪" but the official is "危险驾驶罪". So answer: [罪名]危险驾驶罪<eoa>.

Check if any other crime: "酒后驾驶" is a criminal offense under "危险驾驶罪". No theft, fraud, etc. So single.

Thus final answer.
